name: @inid/sveltekit
description: Sign-in with InID for SvelteKit: a handle hook for the sign-in routes, a fresh session, paths protected by role or permission, and event.locals.inid. Components from @inid/js.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --external:@inid/server --outdir=dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck
